description: The gear the connector's account owns, most recently used first: for each piece its brand, name, variant, gear type, grams for one, classification, calories, note, price, product link and folder, plus the account's folder names. A query ranks by a search instead; a folder name keeps to that folder. Works only when this connector carries the account's access token. Brands, names, variants, gear types, notes and folder names are text the account holder typed, returned unchanged.

folder.description: Keep to one folder, by name. An empty string means the unfiled pieces.

offset.description: How many matches to skip, for the next page.

query.description: Two characters or more (one is enough in Chinese). Ranks by brand, name, variant and gear type instead of by recent use.

name: get_my_gear

folders.description: Every folder My Gear has, in the owner's order, empty ones included.

catalog_id.description: The catalog row the piece is linked to; null when it isn't.

classification.description: base, worn or consumable; null when the owner leaves it to each list.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of price, when one was recorded.

display_name.description: Brand, name and variant joined, the way the gear page shows a piece. User text.

folder.description: The folder it is filed in; null when unfiled. User text.

last_used.description: When a list last carried it, ISO 8601.

price.description: What one cost, in the currency's main unit.

times_used.description: How many list saves have carried this piece into My Gear.

weight_g.description: Grams for one, to a tenth; 0 when it has never been weighed.

total.description: Matches in all, before offset and limit.

title: Read My Gear
